name: Amharic ASR & Summarization System
problem: Amharic, spoken by over 57 million people, lacked robust speech-to-text tools for digital accessibility and automation.
solution: Built an end-to-end ASR pipeline with audio transcription and automatic summarization tailored for Amharic language audio.
description: An automatic speech recognition system for Amharic language that converts audio into text and generates concise summaries.
impact: Enabled Amharic language digital processing for millions of native speakers.

name: Voice Agent STT
problem: Voice-based AI systems needed real-time, low-latency speech recognition for conversational interfaces.
solution: Developed a real-time speech-to-text voice assistant with FastAPI backend for seamless voice interaction.
description: A real-time voice assistant system that converts speech into text for conversational AI applications.
impact: Delivered sub-second transcription latency for interactive voice systems.

name: Offline Real-Time STT System
problem: Internet-dependent STT systems fail in low-connectivity environments common in Africa.
solution: Implemented a fully offline speech recognition engine for real-time transcription without network dependency.
description: An offline speech recognition system capable of real-time transcription without internet connectivity.
impact: Enabled speech AI capability in offline, resource-constrained environments.

name: AI Message Processor
problem: Manual review of high-volume text messages was time-consuming and error-prone.
solution: Built an intelligent NLP pipeline that auto-classifies, processes, and responds to messages.
description: An intelligent NLP pipeline that processes messages and generates meaningful responses automatically.
impact: Reduced message processing time by automating classification and response generation.

name: Intelligent Complaint Analysis
problem: Companies struggled to analyze thousands of customer complaints efficiently to extract actionable insights.
solution: Built a text classification and sentiment analysis system to categorize complaints and surface key pain points.
description: A system that analyzes customer complaints, performs sentiment analysis, and extracts insights.
impact: Enabled real-time customer feedback analysis, reducing manual review by 80%.

name: Credit Card Fraud Detection
problem: Financial fraud causes billions in losses annually; traditional rule-based systems miss novel fraud patterns.
solution: Trained an ensemble ML model using XGBoost and Scikit-learn to detect fraudulent transactions with high precision.
description: A machine learning model that detects fraudulent financial transactions using classification algorithms.
impact: Achieved 97%+ accuracy on imbalanced transaction datasets.

name: Heart Disease Prediction
problem: Early heart disease detection is critical but requires specialized medical analysis.
solution: Developed a predictive ML model using patient vitals to classify heart disease risk.
description: A machine learning model that predicts heart disease risk based on patient data.
impact: Demonstrated ML potential for early clinical risk screening.

name: Stock Market Trend Prediction
problem: Stock market volatility makes forecasting notoriously difficult for traditional statistical models.
solution: Implemented LSTM-based deep learning model to capture temporal dependencies in historical price data.
description: A deep learning model using LSTM to forecast stock market trends based on historical data.
impact: Demonstrated LSTM's capability to model non-linear market trends.

name: Object Detection in Security Imagery
problem: Security agencies needed automated object detection in surveillance imagery to speed up threat identification.
solution: Built a deep learning computer vision model using PyTorch and OpenCV for real-time object detection in security images.
description: A computer vision system that detects objects in security-related images using deep learning.
impact: Enabled automated threat object identification in security scenarios at INSA.

name: Football Player Tracking Data
problem: Raw spatiotemporal tracking data from football matches was unstructured and unusable for analysis.
solution: Designed data engineering pipelines to clean, structure, and enrich football player tracking datasets for ML use.
description: A data engineering project focused on cleaning and structuring football tracking datasets for movement analysis.
impact: Produced clean, research-ready datasets for movement prediction models at Addis Ababa University.

name: Credit Approval Classification
solution: End-to-end pipeline that cleans credit application data, engineers behavioral signals, and trains interpretable classifiers.
description: End-to-end pipeline that cleans credit application data, engineers behavioral signals, and trains interpretable classifiers.

name: Credit Risk Model
solution: Segmented risk modeling framework using feature selection, hyperparameter tuning, and probability calibration.
description: Segmented risk modeling framework using feature selection, hyperparameter tuning, and probability calibration.

description: Healthcare command bot that triages patient messages, routes to specialists, and summarizes chats with LLMs.
